description: Defines structures and functions for frequency resource allocation in 5G NR (3GPP TS38.214), including configuration, RIV calculation, and special case handling.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_get_riv
methods.description: Calculates resource indication value RIV based on resource block configuration.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_from_riv
methods.description: Derives resource block configuration from RIV value.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_special_get_riv
methods.description: Calculates RIV for special cases when standard calculation is not applicable.
